feature.title: P5-1 真实数据源接入 — DataSource ABC + 东方财富/akshare adapters

feature.title: P3 Event-Driven Extensions — F-007/F-008/F-009
feature.description: Sentiment viral propagation (R0, cascade), capital flow divergence scoring, cross-event correlation engine with 8x8 affinity matrix

feature.title: P6 因子研究引擎 — FactorSpec+Registry, FactorEngine, IC/RankIC Auditor, 13传统因子, 因子组合优化, IC衰减分析, 事件因子集成
feature.description: FactorSpec dataclass, FactorRegistry, BaseFactor ABC, FactorEngine (batch/all/PIT validation), IC/RankIC/ICIR computation with A/B/C/D ratings, 13 traditional factors (moment/value/quality/vol/liquidity), portfolio optimizer (equal/IC-weighted/risk-parity), IC decay analysis with half-life, event factor integration (sentiment/capital flow/policy)

feature.title: P1 Market Semantics Foundation — TradingCalendar, Ex-Right Adjustment, Northbound Flow, Index Constituent
feature.description: TradingCalendar frozen dataclass with bisect-based O(log n) T+N arithmetic, Ex-Right price adjustment (forward/backward, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP), Northbound flow momentum/signal producer, Index constituent point-in-time tracking, 1078 tests passed

feature.title: P1-2 Daily Watchlist Generator — 4-dimension scoring, event-driven filtering, portfolio-aware scoring, market semantics validation
feature.description: WatchlistEntry schema extension (priority_score, reason), ScoringEngine with pipeline architecture, 4-dimension weighted sum (signal=0.35, event=0.30, portfolio=0.20, market=0.15), event-driven decay scoring, portfolio-aware thesis/attention scoring, market semantics validation, ranking/filtering, 183 tests, 97% coverage

feature.title: P2 Long-Short Quintile Backtest Engine — 5分位回测、8项指标、因子IC分析、组合收益归因、与P6 FactorEngine集成
feature.description: QuintileSorter, MetricsCalculator (single-pass), ICAnalyzer (RankIC/ICIR), AttributionEngine (Barra-style OLS), LongShortSpread, Parquet persistence with schema versioning, BacktestEngine with DI, 223 tests, 98% coverage

feature.title: P4 Chinese Financial NLP Layer — 8个NLP模块: NER引擎、情感词典、财报解析、新闻情感分类、事件抽取、研报摘要、政策理解、P3集成
feature.description: NEREngine (5 entity types + ticker linking), SentimentLexicon (515+ terms + negation/degree), AnnouncementParser (24 regex patterns), SentimentClassifier (bullish/bearish/neutral + aspects), EventExtractor (5 event types + P3 mapping), ReportSummarizer (5 ratings + target price), PolicyUnderstander (3 issuing bodies + 8 sectors), 6 BaseDetector P3 integrations
